state.task: Resolve ambiguous build choices for CHOOGuard's whole-station NPC world and composed emergencies. Inputs are measured facts from the Busan Station twin and the user's direction; typed judgments only. The user is away and asked that ambiguous judgments be settled with JEV; the main model implements.
state.user_direction: NPCs everywhere: boarding, going to board, getting off, riding elevators and escalators; JEV-based movement; seamless; JEV creates emergencies anywhere (train interiors, outside, platforms).
state.prior_jev_routing_006: atomic world composition 1.00; prefetched next-activity decisions 1.00; moving train cycle 0.99; continuous traversal 1.00; anywhere preconditions hold 1.00; population about 100 (0.59, weak); local interior navigation 0.95.

measured_twin_facts.platforms: Island platforms signed '1', '3·4', '5·6', '8·9', '10·11' are reached from the 2F concourse through north-deck wells and south wells; every well has one escalator lane beside a stair lane. A sign above one well reads '나가는 곳' (way out).
measured_twin_facts.ktx: One 10-car KTX-Sancheon set (cars 1-8, car 3 first class, car 4 has no passenger door) stands at platform 5·6 with its platform-side doors modelled open. Car interiors: aisle about 0.6 m, 13 rows of 2+2 seats in a standard car; floor colliders are missing in the aisle and vestibules.
measured_twin_facts.circulation: Two named 2F-3F escalators (one up, one down); two 1F-2F escalator installations; elevator banks between 1F and the 2F plaza level and between 2F and 3F; toilets on 1F, 2F, 3F; shops and cafes with tables and chairs on 1F, 2F and 3F.
measured_twin_facts.terminus: Busan is the terminus: an arriving set unloads completely and then boards for the return trip.
measured_twin_facts.typical_shift: A shift runs about 8-15 minutes of real time; the first emergency transition is considered after about 1-2 minutes.

state.constraints: Timings are game-compressed and labelled as such. Terror is represented only through observable signs and staff response. JEV answers are advisory (authority 0).

train_timeline.instructions: Which train timeline makes boarding, alighting and platform-bound flows visible early in a short shift while staying plausible for a terminus?

criteria.boarding_first_then_arrival: Shift starts with the set at platform 5·6 boarding for Seoul; it departs after about 2-3 minutes; the next set arrives from Seoul about 2 minutes later and everyone alights; after a short turnaround it boards again. The cycle repeats.
criteria.arrival_first: Shift starts with the set arriving about 40 s in; everyone alights; turnaround; boarding; departure; next arrival later.
criteria.static_boarding_only: The set stays and keeps boarding; no arrivals.

single_escalator_direction.instructions: Each platform well has one escalator beside stairs; the model does not encode running direction. Which direction should these escalators run?

criteria.all_up_way_out: All run up toward the concourse ('way out'): arriving passengers with luggage ride up; departing passengers walk down the stairs or use elevators where available.
criteria.north_up_south_down: North-deck wells run up and south wells run down.
criteria.all_down: All run down toward the platforms.

population_target.instructions: How many people should the world hold, given about 17 ms per editor frame with 100 animated people in one hall?

criteria.about_110_plus_train: About 110 people spread across the concourse, 3F, 1F, plaza and platforms, plus the people inside a docked train (about 30-50).
criteria.about_100_total: About 100 in total including train riders.

first_new_transitions.instructions: Beyond overheating batteries, left-behind luggage and ground shaking (already mechanised), which extra atomic transitions should the composer get in this build so that emergencies can emerge in trains, on platforms and on escalators?

criteria.medical_fall_door: A person collapses (medical) anywhere; a person riding an escalator loses footing and falls (the escalator is stopped by bystanders); a closing train door catches a bag or person and the departure is held.
criteria.track_trespass: A person drops an item on the track and climbs down to fetch it.
criteria.power_outage: A station power outage stops escalators and elevators and traps people in an elevator.

composer_cadence.instructions: How often should the composer ask JEV what happens next, and with how many candidates, so the shift is neither dead nor chaotic?

criteria.every_10_to_16s_12_candidates: Every 10-16 s ask one choice over up to 12 world-derived candidates (sampled across zones) plus 'nothing yet' during the calm phase; once something has happened, keep asking every 10-16 s for developments; a magnitude score is asked only for a chosen transition.
criteria.every_5s_many: Every 5 s over all possible candidates.
criteria.every_45s: Every 45 s over a few candidates.

calm_pressure.instructions: If JEV keeps answering 'nothing yet' during the calm phase, what should the game do?

criteria.drop_nothing_after_3: After three 'nothing yet' answers the option is removed so JEV must compose a first transition from the live candidates (the trainee is on a training shift).
criteria.keep_nothing_forever: Always keep 'nothing yet'; a shift may pass without incident.
criteria.random_fallback: After three answers pick a random candidate locally.
